en.summary: Pupil reports, Class Analysis and Academic Report refined; steadier menus; share a backup from supported devices.
items: Reports and More menus stay open long enough to reach their links.
Academic Report: settings on the left and the A4 preview on the right on wide screens.
Share backup: send a backup through your device’s share options where available. Download backup remains.
Clearer Class Results, Class Analysis (Key Findings, boys and girls), Academic Report (Short or Full, Teacher’s Comment) and Smart Assistant.
No change to your marks, grades, ranks or backup format.

sw.summary: Fomu za ripoti, Uchambuzi wa Darasa na Ripoti ya Taaluma zimeboreshwa; menyu thabiti zaidi; tuma nakala ya hifadhi kwenye vifaa vinavyoruhusu.
items: Menyu za Ripoti na Zaidi hubaki wazi kwa muda wa kutosha kufikia viungo vyake.
Ripoti ya Taaluma: mipangilio upande wa kushoto na A4 upande wa kulia kwenye skrini pana.
Tuma nakala: tuma nakala ya hifadhi kupitia chaguo za kifaa chako zinapopatikana. Pakua nakala inabaki.
Matokeo ya Darasa, Uchambuzi wa Darasa (Mambo Muhimu, wavulana na wasichana), Ripoti ya Taaluma (Fupi au Kamili, Maoni ya Mwalimu) na Msaidizi Mahiri vimeboreshwa.
Hakuna mabadiliko kwenye alama, daraja, nafasi wala muundo wa nakala za hifadhi.
